description: This source file implements dialog rendering and interaction functions for the Wesnoth game, including dialog display, error messages, and network connection dialogs.

classes.name: dialog_manager
classes.description: Manages dialog state, including setting dialog mode and restoring previous state upon destruction.

classes.name: help_handler
classes.description: Handles help hotkey commands within dialogs.

classes.name: connect_waiter
classes.description: A threading waiter that manages waiting for user interaction during network connection dialogs.

methods.name: in_dialog
methods.description: Returns whether a dialog is currently active.

methods.name: draw_dialog_frame
methods.description: Draws the border frame of a dialog with optional style.

methods.name: draw_dialog_background
methods.description: Fills the dialog background with a tiled pattern.

methods.name: draw_dialog
methods.description: Draws the complete dialog box with title, buttons, and optional help button.

methods.name: show_dialog
methods.description: Creates and displays a complex dialog with various options, buttons, and embedded widgets.

methods.name: network_data_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog for receiving network data with progress bar.

methods.name: network_connect_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog for establishing a network connection with user input.
